verse.verse_1: Rivalry in worldly increase distracteth you
verse.verse_2: Until ye come to the graves.
verse.verse_3: Nay, but ye will come to know!
verse.verse_4: Nay, but ye will come to know!
verse.verse_5: Nay, would that ye knew (now) with a sure knowledge!
verse.verse_7: Aye, ye will behold it with sure vision.
verse.verse_8: Then, on that day, ye will be asked concerning pleasure.
